CustomField.inlineHelpText: FALSE means this table generated correctly but must not print. It replaces the renderer-side count() conditional that hid an empty section, so the decision lives in the data where every renderer honours it identically instead of each template re-deriving it. The table is still created, with its Grand Total and counts intact, because those are the evidence generation actually ran - absence of a record cannot be distinguished from a generation that never happened.
CustomField.label: Is Displayed
